title: Full-Stack Engineer - Ads Engine
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We build an ads engine that learns as it goes: brand book, taste, and what actually performs in every market. It plans, generates, localizes, launches and learns from ads across the major ad platforms, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack.
You’ll be a founding engineer for a product area of your own. There’s no PM and no handed-down spec. You’ll talk to users, decide what to build, and ship it across the stack, from data pipelines and agent tools to the UI. Early work could include feeding competitive intelligence into the engine’s weekly briefs or launching a new ad format.
We’re looking for founders and founding engineers. You’d rather ship a rough v0 on Friday than a perfect design doc. Strong engineering is the minimum. What sets people apart is product judgment and ownership.

Requirements

  • Has built and shipped a product end-to-end without anyone handing them a spec, ideally as a founder or one of the first engineers.

  • Strong full-stack product engineer (frontend- or backend-leaning is fine) who can build a pipeline, an agent tool and the UI

  • Builds with LLMs and agents pragmatically: tools, retrieval and evals, not model research.

  • Talks to users without being asked, and can say what they’d build first and why.

Bonus: experience with ad platforms, adtech or marketing tools; analytics and attribution; web builders and CMSs; taste in creative.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and India, with the ability to operate in European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role:

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a senior member of the Paddle legal and compliance team, reporting directly to Paddle’s Director of Legal. The Paddle legal team is well-respected and integrated into Paddle’s business. As a result, this role will require you to collaborate with other teams across the business, and advise cross-functionally, always with a view to empowering the business to achieve its goals while taking a long-term strategic view.

The role itself will be broad and varied, with a core regulatory element. You will be delivering first-rate legal advice in a fast-paced dynamic environment, identifying risk and balancing common sense with your legal expertise. You will be an excellent generalist, comfortable operating in areas of ambiguity.

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will consider the longer-term impacts whilst also being able to react quickly to deliver level-headed, creative and context-appropriate solutions to ensure the best possible customer experience in the ever changing tech space.

The role will be based in the UK but will be global in scope.

What you'll do:

You will support the Director of Legal in their duties and advise and partner with every team from across the business on a wide range of matters, including the following:

  • Leadership remit: As a senior member of the team, you will work as part of a small team of lawyers in a wide range of legal work, including corporate and governance matters, administration of Paddle’s international branches and subsidiaries, negotiating commercial agreements, regulatory research and advising our product and support teams. Your duties may include supervising in-house trainee lawyers seeking their SRA qualification.

  • Strategic commercial work: You will assist in the negotiation of strategic commercial contracts, including key supplier and customer agreements.

  • Strategic corporate work: You will assist with the negotiation of strategic corporate contracts, including financing agreements.

  • Regulatory advice (incl data protection):

    • You will lead on the identification and analysis of evolving rules and consumer regulations relevant to Paddle’s global MoR business model.

    • You will collaborate with the compliance function to develop and implement risk and compliance policies and procedures relevant to Paddle’s operations and the MoR business model.

    • You will draft, negotiate, and advise on data protection agreements, terms of service, privacy policies, and other privacy- and data-related contracts and disclosures, collaborating closely with the compliance function.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • You have a minimum of 8+ years of legal experience, with at least 3 years in-house at a regulated high-growth tech scale-up preferably in payments, FinTech, SaaS or related sectors.

  • You are a UK-qualified solicitor (preferably) or qualified in another common law or European jurisdiction.

  • You enjoy leading and working with junior team members, helping them to grow and realise their potential.

  • You are smart, curious, keen to learn and have a proven ability to quickly get across new and complex legal concepts.

  • You are used to working from first principles, applying common sense, and excited about answering questions you have never dealt with before.

  • You are an excellent and persuasive communicator used to partnering with a range of stakeholders across the business and externally.

  • You are skilled at tailoring your legal advice to the recipient, whether they be senior management or a junior contributor.

  • You are commercially-minded and able to deliver creative, helpful and practical solutions to a rapidly growing business, often operating under pressure and in an area characterized by ambiguity.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

description:

Core operational duties include administering prescribed medications, acting as the lead responder for on-site medical emergencies, managing return-to-study reintegration plans, and maintaining strict governance over medication storage, clinical audits, and confidential UK GDPR-compliant health records.

Strategically, the post-holder leads health policy compliance by aligning procedures with Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), the SEND Code of Practice, and the Equality Act 2010, while managing health-related safeguarding concerns and multi-agency partnerships with external NHS services. A primary mandate is staff development, where the Lead designs and delivers practical training on procedures such as insulin and buccal anti-convulsant administration, evaluating and signing off on individual staff competence. Essential qualifications include a recognised clinical or allied health qualification and First Aid at Work certification, with professional registration (NMC or HCPC) alongside Mental Health First Aid.

Please pay particular attention to the supporting statement of the application, making sure to include details of how you meet each of the essential criteria listed on the person specification.

title: Teacher of Science
description:
Teacher of Science

Fixed Term Contract

January 2027 - August 2027

We are delighted to offer an opportunity for an enthusiastic and inspiring Teacher of Science to join our highly successful Science Department on a fixed-term basis from January 2027 until August 2027.

At Pittville School, we are proud of our inclusive ethos and commitment to ensuring every student achieves their potential. We place staff wellbeing and professional development at the heart of our work and have developed a genuinely supportive environment in which colleagues can thrive.

Whilst this appointment is initially fixed-term, the school anticipates completing curriculum modelling and staffing reviews during the academic year and therefore welcomes applications from candidates seeking to make a significant contribution to the department during this period.

The successful candidate will play an important role in helping our students achieve their potential and will benefit from working within a collaborative department committed to high-quality teaching and professional development.

We welcome applications from both Early Career Teachers and experienced colleagues. The successful candidate will join a highly effective department that is passionate about delivering excellent science education and securing the very best outcomes for students. We are looking for someone who shares our high expectations, enthusiasm for teaching and commitment to helping young people succeed.

The Science Department is housed within six laboratories and consists of seven full-time teachers, one part-time teacher, a member of the Senior Leadership Team and two highly skilled technicians. The department is led by a Curriculum Leader and supported by a second in department. Teachers work closely together to plan, develop and refine curriculum provision, creating a culture of continuous improvement and professional support.

At Key Stage 4, students study AQA Combined Science (Trilogy) and are taught by specialist teachers in Biology, Chemistry and Physics. At Key Stage 3, students follow a carefully sequenced curriculum designed to develop scientific knowledge, curiosity and practical skills. While the ability to teach Biology as a specialism is desirable, applications from teachers of all science specialisms are warmly welcomed.

As a school, we are committed to investing in our staff. All new colleagues benefit from a comprehensive induction programme, high-quality professional development and access to a range of opportunities through our wider professional networks. This sits alongside a strong programme of internal training, collaborative practice and professional learning.

Closing Date: Monday 16th November, 9am

Interview Date: TBC week beginning 16th November

Applications may be reviewed upon receipt, and we reserve the right to interview and appoint before the closing date.

Pittville School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. The successful applicant will be required to undertake all relevant pre-employment checks, including an enhanced DBS check, online searches and satisfactory references. Any offer of employment is subject to these checks being completed successfully. It is an offence to apply for this role if you are barred from engaging in regulated activity with children.

title: Teacher of Science
description:
Teacher of Science

MPS

We are looking for an enthusiastic and qualified Teacher of Science to join our collaborative and supportive Science Department starting in September 2027. The ability to teach Physics is desirable, but we are open to applications from Chemistry or Biology teachers.

This position would suit an experienced teacher or an Early Careers Teacher who is keen to start their career in a friendly and supportive school. We have extensive experience of providing excellent mentoring and support to new staff.

The successful candidate will have access to a full range of courses both in-house and professionally accredited, including all of the National Professional Qualifications eg NPQLTD.

We are an iPad school with all staff and students receiving an iPad (along with regular CPD on how to use it) to support teaching and learning.

This is a unique opportunity to take an exciting role in a forward-thinking school and to work with committed and collaborative staff. The ideal candidate will be passionate about teaching and learning and will have the ability to motivate students. They will be happy to work in support of a large and friendly team.

The Radcliffe School offers the opportunity to:

  • Work with a Department that is passionate about achievement for all pupils.
  • Work with fantastic students who enjoy a dynamic and engaging curriculum.
  • Operate within a diligent team of excellent teachers who have a wealth of expertise and experience.
  • Teach, research, develop and examine at GCSE and A Level.
  • Work with a driven and inspirational department in pursuit of excellence.
  • Be part of a strong induction programme tailored to your experience and needs.
  • Contribute to high quality teaching and learning, and the provision of extracurricular activities to drive students forward.
  • Collaborate within a very supportive environment where professional development is an essential aspect of our daily practice.
  • Develop your career.
  • Contribute to the creation of outstanding student experiences in learning for all.

If you believe that you have the energy, passion, resilience and drive to be part of our positive journey we would love to have you on our team.

Please contact Jo Moloney, HR Manager, on 01908 682 289 or go to www.radcliffeschool.org.uk for more information about the post and an application form.

The deadline for applications is 9am on Friday 20 November 2026. Please note that the advert may be closed as soon as sufficient applications have been received.

title: Safeguarding and inclusion officer
description:
The successful candidate will be expected to play a crucial role in the day to day running of the school’s child protection systems. This role includes supporting all looked after children (LAC) in the school to ensure they engage positively with education, have good attendance and have the required support in place. This role also involves direct support work with students, mentoring, liaising with external agencies and managing referrals. The safeguarding and inclusion officer will monitor all child protection logs on the school’s monitoring system (CPOMS), triage all new cases and oversee the statutory process for each looked after child. The safeguarding and inclusion officer will line manage the welfare officer who runs the medical room, this includes overseeing the main duties and responsibilities of that role. The safeguarding and inclusion officer will also carry out duties and home visits where required.

Highlands is an ‘Outstanding’ school (OFSTED 2011, 2014 and 2024) at which students consistently outperform national expectations in terms of both attainment and progress. Outstanding outcomes provide our students with the opportunity to continue their studies at prestigious institutions; students at Highlands regularly receive offers from medical schools, Oxbridge and Russell Group universities. Colleagues joining Highlands are joining one of the most popular and successful schools in North London.

The work we do at Highlands is underpinned by our values: determination, aspiration, respect and equality (DARE).

Your application should be completed after reading the job description and person specification. Please use the application form to demonstrate how your skills and experience meet the requirements of the role and why you believe you would be a strong candidate.

We are committed to attracting top talent to our school and welcome applications from all members of the community.

title: IT Teacher
description:
Activate Learning has an exciting opportunity available for a passionate and creative ICT and Digital Technologies Teacher to join our teaching team based at Reading College.

Role: IT Teacher

Location: Reading College

Contract: Permanent, full-time role working 37 hours per week Salary: £32,486 - £45,404

What you'll be doing

The post holder will be required to have a range of abilities within ICT and Digital Technologies, including programming, GDPR and other legislation, digital environments, the fundamentals of cyber-security, and design. You will also act as a personal tutor and study programme owner, providing pastoral and academic support to our students.

You will work collaboratively with our existing team of talented and passionate teachers to ensure we plan and deliver purposeful practical and theory lessons. Our students are eager to learn, and we want to appoint someone who can provide them with a high level of knowledge and skills, that they can utilise in their careers or progression to university.

This is a permanent, full-time role working 37 hours per week based at our Reading College.

What we're looking for

You will have a genuine passion for IT with the ability to teach the next generation of programmers and developers and make a positive impact on the lives of young people. You will be responsible for teaching IT and Digital BTech and T-Level Digital Software Development.

To succeed in this role, you'll bring practical expertise in: programming and software development, IT infrastructure, IT legislation, data analytics and management, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals, along with experience using industry-standard platforms.

Candidates should have experience teaching, and hold a qualification or degree in Computing, Information Technology, Computer Science, Digital Technologies, or a related field, along with relevant industry experience in IT or tech.

You'll have

  • Level 3 or above qualification in Computing, Information Technology, or a related digital field Industry experience
  • Experience planning, delivering, and assessing BTEC Level 3 Computing and T Level Digital Software Development

title: Admission Officer
company: St John Fisher Catholic Comprehensive School
description:
Responsible To: Office Manager

Purpose of Job: To lead and be responsible for undertaking the admissions process – providing an effective and efficient service to the school and prospective parents/carers and students.

Person Specification

Essential Skills

  • To be able to work independently as well as being a good team member
  • To be able communicate effectively using good interpersonal skills with various stakeholders including SLT, Governing Body, teachers, students, parents.
  • Good level of education 5+ A*- C grades GCSE
  • Excellent ICT skills: Word, Excel, E-mail, Internet
  • Excellent knowledge of SIMS
  • Organised and methodical working
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to meet strict deadlines
  • Work under pressure
  • Ability to use an admission platform or learn to use it

Principle Roles/Responsibilities

  • Operate as the lead contact for parents seeking admission to the school, explaining and assisting with admissions processes and procedures
  • Process external applications to all year groups, liaising with the Headteacher, Senior Leadership Team and Year Leaders
  • Ensure all relevant paperwork is in place for the Governors’ Admissions Committee
  • Liaise with parents regarding the appeal process when required and compile necessary documentation for appeals (attending appeal hearings when required)
  • Ensure that relevant student information is gathered from previous schools for new admissions and information for those leaving St John Fisher School for other institutions in passed on
  • Take an active role in the preparation of the transition process, including providing parents with the necessary information packs, attending the School Open Evening and the New Intake Information Evening, being available to assist parents with any queries
  • Communicate with all feeder institutions regarding transition including distribution arrangements of documents, prospectus and the like
  • Ensure that a free school meal entitlement check is undertaken for all admissions in order to ensure that free school meal uptake remains as high as possible
  • Maintain waiting lists in collaboration with the local authority and pursue applicants when places become available
  • Liaise with the SEN team over applicants who have an Education and Health Care Plan (EHCP) or special educational needs or English as an Additional Language
  • Produce regular on/off-roll information, including statistics and ensure this is communicated to all the necessary staff and the local authority
  • Liaise with relevant staff to ensure that on-roll dates are clear, that timetables are available for admissions and that students leaving are removed
  • Arrange in-year admissions appointments with relevant staff and ensure all necessary paperwork is available
  • Lead the administrative support provided for all publicity, visits to primary schools, open evenings and open days for entry to year 7 and liaise with the Sixth Form team over publicity events for entry to year 12
  • Produce a variety of typed/word-processed documents, PowerPoint presentations and Excel databases.
  • Be committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and follow the safeguarding policy Staff Development:
  • To assess development and training needs and discuss with line manager.

· To set your own targets before any development activity and review and evaluate the activity after completion, cascading information to the appropriate team when relevant.

  • To keep personal records of all staff development activities in which you are/have been involved.

title: Residential Accommodation Services Manager
description:
Residential Accommodation Services Manager

Wiltshire College & University Centre – Lackham Campus

Be part of something special. Create a place where students feel at home, build confidence and thrive.

Wiltshire College & University Centre is looking for an enthusiastic, experienced and student-focused Residential Accommodation Services Manager to lead our residential provision at Lackham Campus.

This is an excellent opportunity to take the lead in creating an outstanding residential experience for students, ensuring that those living away from home feel safe, supported, included and part of a vibrant college community. You'll be at the heart of campus life, making a real difference to students' wellbeing, independence, personal development and success.

Set within 500 acres of beautiful Wiltshire countryside, Lackham Campus offers a truly unique learning environment. With a commercial farm, Agri-Tech Centre, Animal Centre, engineering workshops and dedicated horticulture areas, our campus is a thriving, practical and industry-focused environment where learners work with real-world land-based systems and emerging technologies.

As Residential Accommodation Services Manager, you'll have the opportunity to shape the residential experience, lead a dedicated team and work alongside colleagues across the college to create a safe, welcoming and supportive home-from-home environment. You'll also play a vital role in ensuring our provision for under-18s meets the relevant Care Standards and the highest expectations of safeguarding and student welfare.

🌟 What We Offer

💷 Salary: £36,955 per year⏱️ Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time 37 hours per week, 52 weeks per year📍 Campus: Lackham Campus


A fantastic opportunity to combine leadership, student wellbeing and operational management in a unique college environment where no two days are the same.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and inspire the residential team, creating a positive, professional and student-focused service.
  • Oversee the day-to-day management of residential accommodation, ensuring high standards across all aspects of provision.
  • Create a welcoming and inclusive residential community where students feel safe, valued and supported.
  • Understand and ensure residential services for under-18s meet the relevant Care Standards, maintaining appropriate policies, procedures and quality assurance arrangements.
  • Take responsibility for student welfare, safeguarding and pastoral care, ensuring concerns are identified and managed effectively.
  • Develop opportunities for residential activities and enrichment that encourage friendships, independence and personal development.
  • Work closely with curriculum, safeguarding and student support teams to provide joined-up support.
  • Build positive relationships with parents, carers, external agencies and other partners.
  • Oversee residential admissions, room allocations, arrivals and departures.
  • Ensure accommodation meets required standards for health and safety, security, cleanliness and maintenance.
  • Manage staffing, budgets and resources effectively, ensuring an efficient and high-quality service.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with college policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead, motivate and develop the residential team, driving high standards and continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience managing residential accommodation, student services, pastoral support or a similar service.
  • Proven experience of leading, motivating and developing a team.
  • A strong understanding of safeguarding, student welfare and pastoral care, particularly for under-18s.
  • Knowledge of the Care Standards and regulatory requirements relating to residential provision for young people.
  • Experience of health and safety, risk management and maintaining safe environments.
  • The confidence to manage challenging situations, make sound decisions and resolve issues effectively.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Experience managing budgets, staffing and operational resources.
  • A positive, proactive and solutions-focused approach.
  • A genuine passion for supporting young people to develop independence, confidence and life skills.
  • The ability to inspire a team and create a culture where high standards, care and accountability go hand in hand.

✨ Why Choose This Path?

This is more than an accommodation management role. It's an opportunity to shape an important part of student life and make a lasting difference to young people.

Join us and enjoy the opportunity to:

  • Lead and develop a residential service that plays a vital role in the student experience.
  • Make a meaningful difference to young people's confidence, independence and wellbeing.
  • Build a positive residential community where students feel they belong.
  • Work alongside passionate colleagues in a unique 500-acre specialist campus environment.
  • Influence the quality, development and future direction of residential provision.
  • Make a visible difference every day, knowing that the environment you create helps students succeed.

⚡ Make a Move That Truly Matters

If you're a passionate residential or student support professional with the leadership skills, energy and enthusiasm to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

This is your opportunity to bring people together, inspire a team and create a residential experience that students will remember for all the right reasons.

🚀 Help us make Lackham more than a place to study. Make it a place where students feel at home, discover their potential and thrive.

Closing Date: 19/11/26

title: Senior Facilities Manager
description:
An exciting leadership opportunity within a growing and ambitious Trust!

                                                                          Kingston Educational Trust is seeking an experienced, proactive and highly motivated Senior Facilities Manager to lead facilities operations and oversee estates management and statutory compliance across our two successful schools, The Kingston Academy and Fern Hill Primary School.

                                                                          This is a key senior operational leadership role, offering the opportunity to shape the strategic direction of our estate while ensuring our schools remain safe, secure, compliant and inspiring environments for pupils and staff.

                                                                          Kingston Educational Trust was established to deliver exceptional education for the communities we serve, building on the success and strong foundations of The Kingston Academy, which opened in September 2015 through a unique partnership between Kingston University, Kingston College, and the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames.

                                                                          These organisations continue to form our Trust membership today and underpin our collaborative, civic-minded ethos.

                                                                          The Role

                                                                          Working closely with Headteachers and senior leaders, you will:

                                                                          • Lead facilities and estates management, including planned maintenance and site improvement programmes.

                                                                          • Oversee statutory compliance, health and safety, risk management and regulatory inspections.

                                                                          • Manage and develop a dedicated facilities team, promoting high standards and continuous improvement.

                                                                          • Oversee contractors, procurement, budgets and maintenance expenditure.

                                                                          • Contribute to long-term estate planning and investment decisions across the Trust.

                                                                          About You

                                                                          We are looking for a confident, solution focused professional with significant experience in facilities, estates or property management.

                                                                          You will bring proven leadership skills, strong knowledge of statutory compliance and health and safety legislation, and experience managing contractors, budgets and maintenance programmes.

                                                                          A NEBOSH General Certificate (or equivalent Level 3 Health & Safety qualification) is essential, alongside an IOSH Managing Safely qualification or willingness to obtain one. Experience within an educational setting would be advantageous.

                                                                          Why Join Us?

                                                                          There are many benefits to working at Kingston Educational Trust, including:

                                                                          • Generous pay scales, regularly paying up to 1% higher than the National Support Staff Pay Scales.

                                                                          • Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme.

                                                                          • Flexible working arrangements may be considered on request.

                                                                          • Employee Assistance Programme, offering free confidential advice and support.

                                                                          • A programme of staff wellbeing initiatives.

                                                                          • Cycle to Work scheme.

                                                                          • Opportunities for high-quality professional development and career progression across the Trust.

                                                                          • A vibrant, supportive and collaborative working environment where staff wellbeing is genuinely prioritised.

                                                                          Interview Procedure

                                                                          Our selection procedure will aim to identify with rigour whether the candidate fulfils the requirements of the post and will include consideration of the candidate's suitability to work with children and young people.

                                                                          The process will include:

                                                                          • A practical task.
                                                                          • Interview with senior staff.

                                                                          Early applications are welcome, and we reserve the right to appoint before the closing date should we identify a suitable candidate.

                                                                          Interview date: To be confirmed.

                                                                          Application Process

                                                                          Applicants are required to visit our website, where they can submit their application via our online recruitment portal.

                                                                          Equal Opportunities

                                                                          At Kingston Educational Trust, we believe that diversity enriches our school community and enhances the educational experience for all. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment that respects and celebrates the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and talents of our staff and students. We welcome applicants from all walks of life and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone. Join us in fostering a culture of diversity and inclusion where every individual is valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.

                                                                          Safeguarding and Safer Recruitment Statement

                                                                          The Kingston Academy is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. We expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment and undergo appropriate pre-employment checks, including an enhanced DBS check (with a Barred List check for regulated activity), references from previous employers, verification of qualifications, and confirmation of eligibility to work in the UK. Identity and qualification documents will be verified prior to any offer of employment.

                                                                          Please refer to the job pack for further information about the role and person specification.

                                                                          We look forward to receiving your application.

title: ICT Technician
description:
ICT Cluster Technician

Salary: SCP 7-11 (£27,274 - £29,071)

Location: North East Cluster (Scunthorpe, Immingham and Grimsby)

Contract: Full Time, 37 hours per week, 52 weeks per year

Launch Your IT Career with Oasis Community Learning

Are you passionate about technology and looking to develop your career in IT? Do you enjoy solving problems, helping people and learning new skills?

At Oasis Community Learning, we believe technology plays a vital role in creating exceptional learning environments where every young person can thrive. We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Cluster Technician to join our North East IT team, supporting our academies across Scunthorpe, Immingham and Grimsby.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build on existing IT knowledge and gain hands-on experience in a diverse and rewarding role. You'll work alongside experienced colleagues, receive ongoing development opportunities and play a key part in supporting the digital technology that underpins teaching, learning and school operations.

As a Cluster Technician, you'll provide frontline IT support across multiple academy sites, helping staff and students make the most of their technology every day. No two days are the same, with responsibilities ranging from troubleshooting issues and deploying new devices to supporting networks, safeguarding systems and technology projects.

Key responsibilities include:

Providing desktop, classroom and deskside technical support to staff and students.

Installing, configuring and maintaining laptops, desktops, iPads and peripheral devices.

Supporting Windows 11 and a range of educational applications and technologies.

Assisting with the maintenance and monitoring of networks, wireless infrastructure and server environments.

Managing and resolving support requests through the Oasis service management system.

Supporting the deployment of new technologies and digital improvement projects.

Maintaining accurate ICT asset records and technical documentation.

Ensuring safeguarding and security software remains operational and up to date.

Delivering excellent customer service and building positive relationships across multiple academy sites.

Regular travel between academies within the cluster will be required.

We're looking for someone who:

Has a genuine interest in technology and developing a career within ICT.

Enjoys troubleshooting and finding practical solutions to technical problems.

Has excellent customer service and communication skills.

Can prioritise workloads and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Is proactive, organised and keen to learn.

Can build positive relationships with colleagues and young people.

Shares our commitment to safeguarding and supporting children and young people.

Is willing to travel regularly between academy sites.

Previous experience in an IT support environment would be beneficial but is not essential. We're equally interested in candidates who can demonstrate enthusiasm, transferable skills and a willingness to learn.

Why Join Oasis?

Working for Oasis means becoming part of a national family of academies united by a shared commitment to transforming lives and strengthening communities. We invest in our people through ongoing professional development, collaborative working and opportunities to grow your career within one of the UK's leading academy trusts.

Our ethos is rooted in inclusion, compassion and aspiration, ensuring that every colleague can make a meaningful contribution while being supported to achieve their full potential.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about technology, customer service and supporting education through reliable and innovative ICT solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Oasis and help create exceptional learning environments where every young person can thrive.

Please note: Oasis Community Learning does not accept unsolicited CVs or speculative introductions from recruitment agencies. We work strictly with agencies on our Preferred Supplier List (PSL), and any CVs submitted outside of this agreement will not be liable for an introduction fee.

title: Teacher of Alternative Provision within Nurture and Strive
description:
TEACHER OF ALTERNATIVE PROVISION WITHIN NURTURE AND STRIVE

Salary: MPS/UPS.

Contract: Permanent. Full Time

Start date: January 2027 or sooner

Place of work: St Peters School, Huntingdon

Place of work:

Teaching is the most rewarding job in the world. We have the opportunity to change students’ lives for the better and you could make a positive impact at St Peter’s School.  

We are a forward thinking and rapidly improving, “good” school that is creating a legacy of learning for our community. Our students Learn, Aspire and Exceed as they work with our highly skilled teaching and associate staff supporting and guiding them. 

St Peter’s is part of The Cam Academy Trust which offers students and staff fantastic potential to collaborate, share and develop a wide range of teaching and learning across the schools in the trust. As a family of schools, we support, share and challenge each other to improve the future lives of all our young people. 

St Peter’s inclusion provision has a good reputation within The Cam Academy Trust and the local area. Our inclusion offer includes our KS3 Nurture provision and STRIVE, our internal alternative provision. This role sits across both.

Our KS3 Nurture provision has been established for 10 years. The Nurture department consists of 5 dedicated teachers leading the curriculum with experience in developing numeracy and literacy. There is a tailored curriculum based on improving students’ basic skills to an age-appropriate level so that they can successfully integrate into secondary school life. The Nurture teachers utilise a wide range of teaching strategies, using an adapted primary model, to improve engagement with education for the students. Class sizes are capped at 17 at a maximum but on average consist of 14 students or fewer.

STRIVE is our internal alternative provision for students in Years 8-11 who display challenging behaviour and are unable to be successful in mainstream education; some students also have SEND needs or an EHCP. Students study English, Maths, Science and Humanities, with those in Years 10 and 11 working towards GCSE qualifications, alongside an enrichment programme that includes AQA Unit Award Scheme certificates. STRIVE takes a broadly restorative approach built on its ethos of Support, Trust, Respect, Invest, Value and Educate, with clear routines, consistent expectations and positive relationships at its heart. Where appropriate, students are supported to reintegrate into mainstream lessons.

The suitable candidate will either be:

an experienced practitioner with SEND or primary experience

an ECT with an in interest in SEND, numeracy and literacy

St Peter’s prides itself in the professional development available to staff, we have had a number of staff complete a wide range of courses including: NPQML, and training with exam board providers as well as in house training. 

We are based in Huntingdon, just 12 miles north of Cambridge with its own mainline station connecting with London in less than an hour. 

For the right candidate, we are able to offer the opportunity to teach lessons across the age and ability range of our students.

For further details on our school please visit our website Home - St Peter's School.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Global Monetization Product and Technology
description:
Responsibilities

The HRBP Global Monetization Product and Technology team partners with leaders across the product, operations, and engineering organizations behind the company's global advertising business. We translate business and technology priorities into people and organizational strategies, shaping workforce plans, organizational design, talent development, performance, and employee engagement.

We work across teams building complex monetization products and infrastructure for different markets, customer needs, and stages of growth. This requires us to understand both technical and commercial priorities, anticipate emerging capability needs, and develop people strategies that connect specialized disciplines across regions. By combining organizational insight with business data and engagement insights, we help teams scale while strengthening leadership and collaboration.

You will build trusted partnerships with leaders and collaborate across HR functions to guide important organization and talent decisions. Your work may span organizational development, workforce and succession planning, leadership development, performance, incentives, culture, and engagement. By staying close to the organization as strategies are implemented, you can see how people decisions shape the teams building global monetization products and technology, and use those insights to strengthen what comes next.

About the Team:
The Global Monetization Product & Technology (GMPT) team powers TikTok's revenue ecosystem. We build the advanced advertising technologies and platforms that enable brands and businesses to connect with audiences worldwide. Our scope spans backend targeting signals, ad measurement infrastructure, and creative tools for advertisers across Brand, SMB, and Performance channels.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will play a key role in scaling this high-impact organization by hiring world-class Product, Design, Data, and Technical talent. This role demands strategic partnership, operational excellence, and a data-driven mindset to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Specifically, you will:
- Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead and manage end-to-end hiring for 10-15+ roles, primarily across Product Management, Product Design, Product Marketing, and Data Science.
- Strategic Partnering: Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders to define hiring needs, advise on market insights, and develop effective recruitment strategies.
- Data-Driven Sourcing: Use data and insights to design sourcing strategies that attract, engage, and convert top-tier technical and product talent globally.
- Market Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert on talent market trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor insights to help inform hiring decisions and workforce planning.
- Operational Excellence: Maintain a high bar for candidate experience, process efficiency, and compliance across all recruiting activities.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with HRBPs, Compensation, and Global TA peers to ensure consistent hiring practices and alignment across regions.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting experience, ideally within high-growth tech or global organizations.
- Proven success hiring across Product Management and/or Product Marketing functions, with additional exposure to technical and data roles.
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and advise.
- Comfortable managing a dynamic requisition load (10-15+) and thriving in an environment of constant evolution and growth.
- Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging recruiting metrics and analytics to drive outcomes and influence decisions.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience supporting global or cross-regional recruiting efforts, with flexibility to collaborate across time zones.
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Excel) to generate reports and insights.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
- Passion for innovation and curiosity about how technology, data, and creativity intersect to drive impact at scale.

You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.

You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

We’re hiring a Developer Advocate. In this role, you’ll play a core part in improving our developer experience, particularly our documentation and example projects. You’ll dive deep into where users are getting stuck and ship what they need to succeed.

You’ll also help drive acquisition of our technical, self-serve customers by creating and presenting engaging content online and in-person, especially at developer meetups and conferences across the globe.

Location

title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Senior Financial Control Analyst

London/Cardiff | £56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

You’ll play a key role by…

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:

  • Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
  • Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
  • Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
  • Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
  • Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
  • Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
  • Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
  • Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
  • Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
  • Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
  • You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
  • You have a great eye for detail
  • You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
  • You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
  • You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
  • You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
  • You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
  • What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

What’s in it for you

£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Recruiter Screening Conversation
  • Initial HM Interview
  • Role Specific Interview
  • Behavioural Interview

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

#LI-TP1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Contract Manager – OFCI Procurement (Data Centers)
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Contract Manager – OFCI Procurement is responsible for the commercial strategy, negotiation, and administration of OFCI equipment contracts for data center projects. The role focuses on protecting the owner’s commercial position across high-value, long-lead equipment packages while ensuring contractual alignment with project schedule, delivery milestones, and risk allocation.

The position partners closely with procurement, legal, finance, and project teams to manage supplier contracts from tender through close-out.

Your responsibilities will include:

Commercial Strategy & Contract Formation

  • Develop commercial and contractual strategies for OFCI equipment packages
  • Lead commercial negotiations with equipment suppliers and manufacturers
  • Draft, review, and finalize supply agreements, purchase orders, and amendments
  • Ensure clear allocation of risk related to delivery, performance, escalation, and force majeure
  • Align contract structures with project cash flow and financing requirements

Pricing, Payments & Cost Control

  • Negotiate pricing models, payment milestones, retention, and security instruments
  • Manage price escalation, indexation, currency exposure, and tax considerations
  • Support cost forecasting, cash flow planning, and budget compliance
  • Review and approve supplier invoices and payment applications

Risk, Claims & Change Management

  • Define and enforce liquidated damages, delay remedies, and performance guarantees
  • Manage contract variations, change orders, and commercial impacts
  • Support claims avoidance and resolution with suppliers
  • Coordinate dispute resolution activities where required

Contract Administration & Governance

  • Administer OFCI contracts throughout engineering, manufacturing, and delivery phases
  • Issue contractual notices, correspondence, and approvals in line with contract terms
  • Ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and approval authorities
  • Maintain accurate and auditable contract records

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary commercial interface with OFCI equipment vendors
  • Support procurement and project teams during bid evaluations and award decisions
  • Coordinate with legal, finance, tax, and insurance stakeholders
  • Participate in supplier performance reviews and escalation meetings

Schedule & Delivery Alignment

  • Monitor contractual delivery milestones and long-lead commitments
  • Support mitigation strategies for supplier delays or capacity constraints
  • Ensure commercial alignment between OFCI supply contracts and installation contractors

Closeout & Final Accounts

  • Manage contract closeout, final settlements, and release of securities
  • Ensure contractual delivery of warranties, guarantees, and documentation
  • Support transition from project execution to operations

We expect you to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, Engineering, or related field
  • 8+ years of experience in contract or commercial management on capital projects
  • Strong experience with supplier negotiations and contract administration
  • Proven track record managing high-value, long-lead equipment contracts
  • Experience in data center or mission-critical infrastructure projects
  • Experience with NetSuite and procurement workflow tools — PR/PO lifecycle, vendor setup, item/category master data
  • Comfortable working with large procurement datasets and reconciling figures across multiple systems (ERP vs procurement tool vs vendor records)

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with international procurement and multi-currency contracts
  • Familiarity with standard contract forms (FIDIC or equivalent)
  • Exposure to large-scale, owner-led or EPCM project models

Competencies & Behavioral Traits:

  • Commercial negotiation and risk allocation
  • Contract drafting and administration
  • Cost control and cash flow management
  • Claims and change management
  • Strong stakeholder communication

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Vertical Sales Strategy and Operations
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins.

  • Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction.

  • Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product.

  • Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back.

  • Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

  • Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

  • Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion

  • Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams.

  • Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need

  • Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority.

  • Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort operating in a fast-moving, undefined space.

  • Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
