title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer I - Germany/Austria/UK
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it.

 This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation.

 You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team.

 We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

 Database platform (approx. 60%)

• Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths.

• Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions.

• Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene.

• Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path.

• Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require.

• Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability.

 Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%)

• Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes.

• Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them.

• Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant.

 Team, incidents, and collaboration

• Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence.

• Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person.

• Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS

 Required — PostgreSQL depth

• 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL.

• Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning.

• Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services.

• Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables.

• Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies.

 Required — Infrastructure and ways of working

• Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS.

• Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling.

• Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation).

• Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes.

• Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists.

• Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Nice to have

• Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued).

• Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load.

• Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows.

• Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional).

 MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

 Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

 GENERAL TERMS

 Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .

 All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

 Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor

 If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com

title: MSP Mac Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com

 URL: https://ignitionit.com

 Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first

 TL;DR

 ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.

 We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.

 What the actual job???

 Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”

 You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.

 In a typical week, you might:

•
 Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.

•
 Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.

•
 Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.

•
 Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.

•
 Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."

 ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.

 About ignitionit.com

 We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!

 What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.

 We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

 If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.

 The tech you'll work with (and grow into)

 Day one, you'll be living in:

•
 Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)

•
 Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows

•
 Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles

•
 Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)

•
 Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client

•
 The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling

 ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.

 Who we hope you are

 The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:

•
 Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)

•
 Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband

•
 Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem

•
 Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job.

 ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:

•
 Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people

•
 Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time

•
 Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it

•
 Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line

•
 Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former

•
 Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)

•
 Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)

•
 Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously

 Regarding AI

 Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.

 Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.

 Compensation & logistics

•
 Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk.

•
 Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.

•
 Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.

 How to apply

 The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:

•
 Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.

•
 If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.

•
 From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.

 If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?

 Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!

title: Director, Partner Operations
description:
Headquarters: USA - Remote

 About Ping Identity:

 At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

 Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

 While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

 We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

 Position Summary

 As the Director of Partner Operations, you will lead the operational engine that powers our global partner ecosystem. You will be responsible for building and optimizing processes, tools, and programs that support all partner types—resell, referral, delivery, technology, MSP, and cloud marketplaces.

 You will collaborate closely with Sales Operations, Channel Sales, Alliances, Product, Finance, and Marketing to ensure our partner strategy is supported by scalable infrastructure and clear performance metrics.

 Please note: while this is a remote role, we are seeking candidates based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to support close collaboration with our West Coast channel leadership.

 Key Responsibilities

• Partner Operations Strategy

• Lead the development and execution of partner operations strategy aligned to business growth goals.

• Design and implement scalable processes to support a diverse partner ecosystem, including resellers, referral partners, GSIs, SIs, MSPs, ISVs, and cloud marketplaces (e.g., AWS, Azure).

• Build dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure partner performance, pipeline, and influence.

• Sales Operations Alignment

• Partner with Sales Ops and RevOps to integrate partner data into core sales systems (Salesforce, PRM, BI tools).

• Optimize lead-to-cash processes for indirect routes, including partner deal registration, attribution, and compensation.

• Partner Program & Enablement

• Support ongoing evolution of Ping’s partner program, tiers, incentives, and benefits.

• Ensure operational support for onboarding, certification, and enablement workflows.

• Track partner participation and compliance with program requirements.

• Technology & Systems Ownership

• Own or influence tools that support partner lifecycle (e.g., PRM, Salesforce, LMS, partner portals).

• Work with IT and vendors to enhance partner system capabilities and integrations.

• Cross-functional Leadership

• Serve as the key operations point of contact for Partner Sales, Alliances, and Executive Leadership.

• Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to support GTM alignment with technology and cloud partners.

 Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Channel/Partner Operations, or similar roles in B2B SaaS environments.

• Deep understanding of partner ecosystems including VARs, GSIs, ISVs, MSPs, and hyperscalers.

• Strong experience with partner programs and partner enablement frameworks.

• Proven ability to manage and improve sales/partner systems and data quality across CRM and PRM platforms.

• Analytical mindset with experience in forecasting, attribution modeling, and performance analytics.

• Excellent project management and cross-functional communication skills.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, PRM tools (e.g., Impartner, Allbound, or similar), and BI/reporting platforms.

• Prior identity/security SaaS experience is a plus.

 Compensation: $180,000–$200,000 base + variable bonus

 In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.
 Life at Ping:

 We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

 Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

• A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

• Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

• Regular company and team bonding events.

• Competitive benefits and perks.

• Global volunteering and community initiatives

 Our Benefits:

• Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule

• Parental Leave

• Progressive Healthcare Options

• Retirement Programs

• Opportunity for Education Reimbursement

• Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

 Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

 We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


What We're About
 
At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around using data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.
 
The Role
 
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to manufacture high-quality products is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into a reality.
 
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most exciting problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into an understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.
 
You'll immerse yourself in our customers' most intricate workflows. You'll partner with customer teams and explore the data, and plunge into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll seek will require a curious and analytical approach, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user insight to ultimately empower our customers to improve decisions.

The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer

We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join Salesforce in London as the regional field marketing lead for our Platform business across EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) and the UK and Ireland, including Agentforce and our security and developer services. You will own the full-funnel plan and the marketing-driven pipeline for the region, and build lasting relationships with senior security, IT and data leaders.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Set and deliver the regional field marketing strategy and quarterly plan, turning a significant program budget into measurable pipeline and revenue growth across events, digital and organic activity.
  • Design and host small, invite-only executive forums, CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) roundtables and Gartner executive summits that open doors for Agentforce and security-led deals.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, senior Sales leaders and the UK and Ireland field leader to agree on priorities, target accounts and follow-up, and report results with a clear business story.
  • Guide Field Marketing Analysts on workshops, webinars and digital programs, and manage agency and event partners, without direct line management.

You're Our Person If...

  • You have 10 or more years of marketing experience, including field marketing, with a record of owning and delivering pipeline and revenue targets.
  • You have designed and delivered high-touch, in-person executive events and engaged C-level and senior technical buyers.
  • You have built strong alignment with Product Marketing and Sales leaders and can manage a budget, quarterly plan and KPIs independently across several markets.
  • Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, etc.)

Even Better If...

  • You have security or technology marketing experience, including CISO or Gartner executive programs.
  • You have experience with CRM, campaign management and marketing reporting tools.
  • You have mentored junior colleagues.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

If you would like to apply under the scheme, please click the link to the Accommodations Request Form above and scroll to the UK Disability Confident Scheme section within the form.

Posting Statement

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 About the Role

 As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

 Key Responsibilities

• Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

• Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

• Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

• Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

• QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

• Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

• Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

• Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

• Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

• Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

 Qualifications

 Required

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.

• Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

• Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

• Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

• A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

• Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

• Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

• Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

 Preferred

• Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

• Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

• Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

• Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

• Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

• Agency or consulting experience.

 Why Current

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

 You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

 This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-freelance-marketo-email-engineer

"I can be myself at work."

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness-and we're committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long-Term Thinking, and Community.

"I can influence my income."

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You'll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

"I can lead a full life."

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you're raising a family, you're passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we'll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

  • Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options
  • Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love
  • Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

About Equity Trade Operations Analysts:

The Equity Trade Operations Analyst works as part of a global team performing and reviewing exception handling across all accounts and products and for all levels of complexity. They independently apply experience and judgement to analyzing exceptions, identifying the appropriate course of action, determining who should be involved in resolving the issue or exception, and implementing solutions. For particularly complex/ambiguous issues, they work with the Lead Analyst to determine the appropriate course of action. They possess a growth

mindset and proactively identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement efforts with oversight from the Lead as needed. The role may lead small to moderately sized internal or external projects and priorities.

Role Summary:

  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in their assigned areas and obtains guidance from the Lead, as needed.
  • Performs and/or provides oversight of daily production and delivery of work to identify, assess, and resolve exceptions for a specific area of focus. Operates as a technical subject matter expert for their area.
  • Applies knowledge, experience, sound judgement, and business acumen, to analyze, assess, recommend, and implement solutions in a timely manner and in response to identified exceptions with oversight from the Lead, as necessary.
  • Collaborates with other Equity Operations facing departments (e.g., legal & compliance, trading, core operations, and vendors) to diagnose and resolve issues and/or move the business forward.
  • Performs and/or monitors more complex operational duties for investment vehicles servicing the Institutional, Retail, and High-Net Worth distribution channels. Performs trade confirmation, processing, settlement and claims for global equity markets.
  • Identifies, recommends, and participates in continuous improvement activities.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Able to assess issues, identify potential solutions, and implement changes/improvements to achieve the right outcomes and that have tangible and impactful implications for the business. For complex/ambiguous issues, will collaborate with Lead Analyst on best course of action
  • Proactively identify opportunities and drive implementation with oversight as needed
  • Ability to lead and effectively manage process and procedural changes
  • Ability to apply a global mindset when working through issues or developing solutions
  • Existing knowledge of, or ability to quickly assimilate to, Capital Group-specific institutional practices and knowledge (e.g., knowledge of the investment management industry as it relates to Capital Group's various lines of business (e.g., Retail, Institutional, High Net Worth), investment mandates, investment vehicle structures, investment operations, competitive landscape, and reporting and regulatory environment. Exhibits and shares knowledge in policies, practices, trends, technology, and information affecting the department/business area)
  • Self-driven (e.g., independently manage workload and achieve target outcomes)
  • Strong business acumen to understand and anticipate business needs/requirements and use business language in verbal and written communications
  • Work effectively across internal and external stakeholder groups with the appropriate level of urgency to solve issues and deliver outcomes in a timely manner
  • Strong collaboration skills, working within and across teams and stakeholder groups to proactively develop strong working relationships
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills including with senior stakeholders/leadership with a focus on being able to communicate 'the why' behind issues
  • Strong appetite and capability to shape and deliver continuous improvement activity

title: Customer Value Architect III
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, US (Remote)

 About Mixpanel

 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

 About the Team

 The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.

 About the Role

 The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.

 Responsibilities

• Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.

• Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.

• Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.

• Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.

• Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.

• Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.

• Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.

• Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.

• Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.

• Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.

 We're Looking For Someone Who Has

• 4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.

• A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.

• The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.

• Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.

• Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.

• A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.

• Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first.

 Bonus Points For

• Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.

• Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity.

• Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.

title: Global Alliance Lead, Capgemini
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Colorado, United States, AMER

 From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us

 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the role

 The Global Alliance Lead is one of the most strategically important roles in our Ecosystem. You will own our relationship with one of the world's leading technology and transformation partners end-to-end — from C-suite engagement through to practitioner enablement and joint pipeline creation. You will be the architect of how the GSI and NewCo go to market together, ensuring our platform becomes the trusted data foundation inside the GSI’s agentic AI delivery practice globally.

 This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Global Head of GSI Relationships. You will orchestrate across sales, partner solution architecture, marketing, and partner operations — bringing the full weight of the organisation to bear on one of our highest-leverage commercial relationships.

 What You'll Do

 Relationship strategy and executive engagement

• Own the global GSI relationship at partner and C-suite level, building trusted relationships with Client, practice and delivery team leads.

• Define and execute a multi-year joint strategy that positions dbt + Fivetran as the default open data infrastructure layer within the GSI’s enterprise AI and agentic workflow delivery

• Represent NewCo at GSI’s internal forums, client briefings, and industry events — articulating a compelling narrative around open data infrastructure and its relevance to the GSI’s strategy.

 Platform integration and practitioner adoption

• Drive adoption of the dbt + Fivetran platform within GSI delivery teams — ensuring practitioners, solution architects and practice leads are certified, confident, and actively recommending the platform in client engagements

• Work with GSI's practice leadership to embed NewCo's platform into their business groups, standard delivery architectures, RFP responses and client proposals — with particular focus on GSI's Data & AI practices

 Enablement and go-to-market

• Design and execute a frictionless enablement programme for GSI practitioners globally — certifications, reference architectures, use case playbooks, and joint delivery assets

• Partner with GSI's marketing and alliances teams to develop joint go-to-market campaigns anchored to open data infrastructure, trusted AI delivery, and closing the gap between AI POC and production

• Support GSI in building and positioning client-facing agentic AI value accelerators — with NewCo platform as the foundational data layer — the "NewCo inside" model

 Pipeline and opportunity development

• Source and develop new pipeline opportunities through the GSI relationship — identifying client situations where open data infrastructure creates measurable value.

• Drive co-sell motions alongside GSI account teams, ensuring NewCo is present and influential at the point of client opportunity

• Maintain a rigorous view of GSI-engaged pipeline — tracking opportunity sourcing, progression, and closed business attributed to the alliance

 Telemetry and performance

• Define and track the signals that indicate a healthy, high-performing GSI relationship: certifications, sourced opportunities, platform deployments, practitioner engagement, and joint wins

• Report regularly to the Global Head of GSI Relationships on alliance health, pipeline contribution, and strategic progress

• Identify risks and gaps in the relationship early and mobilise internal resources to address them

 What you will bring

• 15+ years of experience in strategic alliances, enterprise sales, or partner management within the data, cloud, or enterprise software industry

• Demonstrated experience managing complex, global relationships with major consulting firms or global system integrators at a senior level

• Deep understanding of the modern data stack and the business value of open data infrastructure — dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent experience strongly preferred

• Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and partner level within a global consulting organisation — understanding how GSIs make decisions, build practices, and go to market

• Strong commercial instincts — able to identify, thoroughly qualify and develop joint pipeline opportunities, not just manage existing relationships

• Track record of operating as a cross-functional orchestrator — influencing without direct authority across sales, engineering, marketing, and operations

• Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — able to translate technical platform capabilities into compelling business narratives for consulting and enterprise audiences

• Familiarity with AI, agentic workflows, and the data governance landscape is a strong advantage + strong knowledge of GSI's operating model and contacts within.

• Willingness to travel globally to engage GSI leadership and teams across regions

 What Success Looks Like in Year One

• A clearly defined joint strategy with GSI signed off at partner Executive level and on track to primary Global Strategic Practice.

• Material increase in GSI practitioner certifications and active platform deployments across Data & AI and Insights & Data practices

• GSI-sourced pipeline contributing measurably to NewCo's revenue

• At least two joint go-to-market campaigns live in the market delivering pipeline — anchored to GSI's agentic AI and trusted data agenda

• First client-facing agentic value accelerators built on NewCo platform delivered with GSI — positioning NewCo as the trusted data infrastructure inside GSI's AI delivery

• A telemetry framework in place tracking alliance health and pipeline influence

 Why This Role

 This is a rare opportunity to own a marquee relationship at a defining moment for both companies. GSI’s are publicly committing to capturing the full value of the agentic AI revolution for customers — and the merged dbt + Fivetran platform is the trusted data infrastructure that makes AI production-ready. The person who builds this alliance well will sit at the intersection of the two most important forces in enterprise technology right now: the scale of a global systems integrator and the open infrastructure that makes AI trustworthy enough to deploy at scale.

 This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia

 URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/

 We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 How it works

• Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

• Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

• Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

• Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

• Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

• Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

• Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 Requirements

• 2+ years of professional software engineering

• Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

• Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

• Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

• Regular use of an AI coding tool

• Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

• You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

• At least 10 hours a week, starting now

• A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 Nice to have

• Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

• Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 Terms

• US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

• Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

• The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

• Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Headquarters: London

 URL: http://www.medify.co.uk

 Remote | Full-Time | UK

 About Us

 At Medify, we’re on a mission to widen access to medicine and healthcare careers through world-class digital learning experiences. Since 2009, we’ve helped thousands of students prepare for high-stakes admissions tests, and we’re continuing to invest in our technology to build innovative, scalable products that support learners around the world.

 As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead, mentor and develop our engineering team while remaining hands-on in building the platform that powers Medify.

 The Role

 As an Engineering Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping both our engineering culture and technical direction. Working closely with the CTO, Product and Design teams, you’ll lead a team of talented full-stack engineers, helping them grow while ensuring we continue to deliver high-quality software that delights our users.

 This is a hands-on leadership role, with at least 50% of your time dedicated to engineering. You’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle - from architecture and design through to development, testing and deployment - while driving engineering excellence and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team.

 Our current technology stack includes Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, with infrastructure transitioning from Heroku to AWS.

 Key Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor and support a team of full-stack engineers through coaching, regular 1:1s and performance reviews.

• Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.

• Support career development, engagement and long-term capability building across the engineering team.

• Contribute to hiring by supporting interviews and recruitment of exceptional engineering talent.

• Design, develop and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.

• Collaborate closely with Product and Design teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.

• Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the Medify platform.

• Conduct thoughtful code reviews and promote engineering best practices.

• Troubleshoot and resolve software issues while maintaining high standards of reliability and performance.

• Develop automated tests and contribute to a robust testing culture.

• Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement and sprint delivery.

• Stay up to date with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve our engineering practices.

 About You

 You’ll be a technically strong engineering leader who enjoys developing people just as much as building great software. You’re comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on development and thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.

 You’ll ideally have:

• 2+ years’ experience leading or managing software engineering teams.

• 5+ years’ experience in software development.

• Strong experience with modern software engineering practices and frameworks.

• Experience with Ruby on Rails and React (highly desirable).

• A proven track record of building scalable, maintainable software.

• Experience working in Agile development environments.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional Product and Design teams.

• Experience recruiting, mentoring and developing engineers.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Excellent problem-solving ability with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.

 Qualifications

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable, but not essential.

 Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of modern programming languages and software frameworks.

• Excellent understanding of software architecture, design principles, data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with relational databases, APIs and networking.

• Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and software quality practices.

• Familiarity with DevOps tools and deployment pipelines.

• Ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

 ✅ What We Offer

• Fully remote working with flexibility and autonomy.

• The opportunity to shape the future of Medify’s technology platform.

• A supportive, collaborative engineering culture that values continuous learning.

• A hands-on leadership role with real technical influence.

• The opportunity to work on products that positively impact thousands of aspiring healthcare professionals every year.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

 How to Apply

 If you’re passionate about building exceptional software, developing high-performing engineering teams and making a meaningful impact in education, we’d love to hear from you.

 Submit your application along with your CV using the link attached.

Headquarters: Remote - Canada

 This is Engineering at Lattice

 Lattice’s Engineering team is continuously working to better both our product and our craft. We use a modern, cutting-edge tech stack and love experimenting with new technologies. We strive for maintainable, robust, and performant code. We’re highly collaborative and continuously iterative, and work closely with designers and product managers. title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

 About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

 We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

 Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

 Our Core Technologies

 Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

 What You'll Do

 • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

 • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

 • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

 • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

 • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

 • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

 • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

 • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

 • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

 • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

 • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

 What We Look For:

 • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

 • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

 • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

 • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

 • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

 • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

 • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

 • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

 Nice To Have:

 • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

 • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

 • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

 • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

 • Conversation design or UX writing experience

 What We Offer You:

 • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

 • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

 • Flexible PTO

 • Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

 • Health & wellness initiatives

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

 About the Team

 The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

 You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

 Role Description

 As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

 You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

 This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

 The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

 What we look for

• Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

• Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

• Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

• Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

• Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

 About Databricks

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

 Benefits

 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

 Compliance

We are seeking a Privacy Compliance Associate to join our Data Governance & AI Non-Financial Risk team, supporting Morgan Stanley in meeting its privacy and data protection obligations. The role will work across business lines to help ensure global Data Subject Rights requests, including access and erasure requests, are managed appropriately and responded to within required timeframes.

In the Legal & Compliance division, we assist the Firm in achieving its business objectives by facilitating and overseeing the Firm's management of legal, regulatory and franchise risk. This is an Associate level position within the Privacy Non-Financial Risk (NFR) team who are part of the second line of defence, governing and overseeing data subject rights requests and privacy across the Firm.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What you'll do in the role:

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm when responding to Data Subject Rights requests, including data subject access requests (DSARs) and erasure requests, within statutory deadlines.

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm with the intake, processing, redactions and quality assurance checks of request responses.

- Support Privacy NFR with oversight activity including monitoring of dashboards and production of metrics for reporting to colleagues, partners and governance groups.

- Support Privacy NFR by providing advice and guidance on global Data Subject Rights to key stakeholders across the Firm.

- Enhance policies, procedures, processes, reporting, training and support ad-hoc projects as required.

What you'll bring to the role:

- Ability to collaborate and partner with cross-functional teams, business units and individuals at all levels.

- Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

- Proactive work ethic and team player mindset.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.
